question: Why were additional distinguishing terms introduced for the path-sphere?
premises: Additional distinguishing terms were taken up for this purpose.
The discussion concerns states of only that limited extent.
Those states occur in the path-sphere dependent on maya.
inference: Therefore extra distinguishing terms were needed to prevent confusion in the maya-dependent path-sphere.
uncertainties: The exact set of bhedaka terms is not enumerated in this verse.
plain_english: For that reason, other distinguishing terms were introduced, so that in the limited states of the path-sphere dependent on maya there would be no confusion.
